title: CI/CD Pipelines
prereqs: python3 + pyyaml for the config challenges
Docker + kind for the build/deploy challenges
description: Build delivery pipelines that are fast, safe and secure: GitHub Actions (workflows, jobs, matrix, caching, secrets, OIDC), build/test/lint gates & coverage, container build + scan (trivy) + sign (cosign/SBOM), deployment strategies (blue-green, canary, progressive), GitOps handoff to Argo CD, and pipeline supply-chain security (pinned actions, least privilege). Challenges author real pipeline config and run real gates.
